The '''Tagge battlecruiser''' was a type of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] produced by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]<ref name="GATORW" /> and fielded during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SW35" />

==Characteristics==
The [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] design was dagger-shaped, like the contemporary [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]]. They were sizable, and similar to regular [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyers]] in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SW35" />

==History==
These warships were pledged by the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] in support of Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]] during the [[Yavin blockade]], and were under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]]. The official reason for their deployment, however, was to curb mining strikes in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].<ref name="SW25">[[Star Wars (1977) 25|''Star Wars'' (1977) 25]]</ref>
The family patriarch, [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]], used his brother's position to conduct operations throughout the blockade without the Empire's knowledge, in order to discredit his rival, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="GATORW" />

During the [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]] fiasco, [[General Tagge's battlecruiser|Tagge's personal battlecruiser]] was [[Battle of the Corridor|attacked]] by a fleet of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] gunships. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] got in a precise hit, pierced one of its shields and hit a reserve reactor, forcing the General and his staff to flee in an escape craft.<ref name="SW35" />

== Behind the scenes ==
The "Tagge Battlecruiser," first appeared in Star Wars (1977) 31 as an Imperial battle cruiser under the command of Ulric Tagge. In the comics Ulric's ship is referred to as an "Imperial Battle Cruiser" in Issue 31,<ref name="SW35" /> and "Imperial Star Destroyer" in Issue 33,<ref>[[Star Wars (1977) 33|''Star Wars'' (1977) 33]]</ref> an alternation also used for other Imperial ships in the comic run. In [[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds|Geonisis and the Outer Rim Worlds]] however, Ulric's forces are described as being provided by the House of Tagge to the Imperial blockade of the Gordian Reach rather than part of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="GATORW" />
